headline.en: Give desktop automation an inspectable action tree.
headline.zh: 让桌面自动化使用可检查的动作树。

sub.en: uia-agent snapshots a Windows accessibility tree, prunes it into a compact action frame, and dispatches typed actions through supported UIA patterns.
sub.zh: uia-agent 快照 Windows 无障碍树，将其裁剪为紧凑动作帧，并通过支持的 UIA pattern 分发类型化动作。

body.en: Names, values and supported patterns stay visible.
body.zh: 名称、值和支持的 pattern 保持可见。

body.en: Depth and node budgets limit the traversed tree.
body.zh: 深度和节点预算限制遍历树。

body.en: Actions target UIA patterns through one dispatcher.
body.zh: 动作通过统一分发器调用 UIA pattern。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: The portable example provides three fake controls to the production snapshot walker and checks which two remain.
note.zh: 可移植示例向生产快照遍历器提供三个假控件，检查最终保留的两个节点。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Production UIA tree pruning and stable snapshot IDs on a complete fake control tree. No Windows desktop, native UI action or model call is exercised.
steps.output:
input nodes: 3
retained nodes: 2
retained: Button Save ['Invoke']
stable snapshot IDs: True

body.en: The portable example provides three fake controls to the production snapshot walker and checks which two remain.
body.zh: 可移植示例向生产快照遍历器提供三个假控件，检查最终保留的两个节点。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/uia-agent.git
cd uia-agent
uv venv .venv
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python pydantic
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python --no-deps -e .

limitations.en: Native automation requires an interactive Windows desktop and applications with useful UIA controls. The offline example cannot validate that environment.
limitations.zh: 原生自动化需要交互式 Windows 桌面，以及具有可用 UIA 控件的应用。离线示例无法验证该环境。

limitations.en: The demonstration uses a fake control tree and tests pruning only; it does not click, type, call a model or automate a real app.
limitations.zh: 演示使用假控件树，只测试裁剪，不点击、输入、调用模型或自动操作实际应用。

limitations.en: Model-driven actions can change application data. A model-reported done action is not independent proof that the user’s goal succeeded.
limitations.zh: 模型驱动操作可能改变应用数据。模型报告 done 不等于目标已被独立验证完成。

body.en: Legacy desktop applications often expose accessible controls even when no application API is available. A tree of named controls gives a model a structured place to choose its next action.
body.zh: 旧桌面应用即使没有业务 API，也可能暴露无障碍控件。带名称的控件树为模型选择下一步操作提供结构化依据。

body.en: uia_tree walks controls under depth and node budgets and assigns stable IDs. The model adapter returns one Action; actions dispatches it through control patterns. The agent repeats observation and action within its step budget. Optional adapters expose the same workflow to MCP or LangChain.
body.zh: uia_tree 在深度和节点预算内遍历控件并分配稳定 ID。模型适配器返回一个 Action，actions 通过控件 pattern 分发。Agent 在步数预算内重复观察与操作，可选适配器将流程暴露给 MCP 或 LangChain。

body.en: uia_tree walks controls under depth and node budgets and assigns stable IDs. The model adapter returns one Action; actions dispatches it through control patterns. The agent repeats observation and action within its step budget. Optional adapters expose the same workflow to MCP or LangChain.
body.zh: uia_tree 在深度和节点预算内遍历控件并分配稳定 ID。模型适配器返回一个 Action，actions 通过控件 pattern 分发。Agent 在步数预算内重复观察与操作，可选适配器将流程暴露给 MCP 或 LangChain。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: For the portable tree example, only pydantic and the source package are needed; the setup below intentionally uses --no-deps. For native Windows automation, install the full package with python -m pip install -e . in a Windows environment. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY provides credentials; UIA_AGENT_PROVIDER and UIA_AGENT_MODEL select the provider/model. Windows venv Python is .venv\Scripts\python.exe.
body.zh: 可移植树示例仅需 pydantic 与源码包，因此下方安装明确使用 --no-deps。实际 Windows 自动化应在 Windows 环境执行 python -m pip install -e . 安装完整依赖。ANTHROPIC_API_KEY 或 OPENAI_API_KEY 提供凭据，UIA_AGENT_PROVIDER 与 UIA_AGENT_MODEL 选择提供方/模型。Windows 虚拟环境解释器路径为 .venv\Scripts\python.exe。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
# On Windows, in a fully installed environment:
uia-agent dump --app Notepad --indent 0
uia-agent run --app Calculator --max-steps 15 "Compute 17 * 23"
